object.description: Commit a change from the commit dialog with tag name CDR-1.0 and message 'Critical design review'; create a tag with no message; commit with no tag name and with an empty one. Expected: CDR-1.0 is an annotated tag on the new commit, with the message and git's user as tagger; a tag without a message takes its name as message; without a tag name no tag is created.
